## Checklist
- [ ] I have read and followed `prime_directive.md`
- [ ] I worked on a feature branch
- [ ] I inspected existing code before changing it
- [ ] I added or updated tests where appropriate
- [ ] All relevant tests pass
- [ ] UI changes were manually tested, if applicable
- [ ] Browser console was checked for UI changes, if applicable
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are included
- [ ] Any anomalies were investigated rather than worked around
- [ ] Handoff notes are complete

## Review Closure (`PR_REVIEW_CLOSURE_POLICY.md`)

Complete before requesting merge:

- [ ] Every issue comment, review submission and inline thread has a written disposition
- [ ] Dispositions use `Fixed in <commit>` / `No change` + rationale / `Deferred to #<issue>` / `Superseded by <commit or PR>` / clarification requested
- [ ] Every deferred concern has a linked issue with owner, priority and acceptance criteria
- [ ] Automated-reviewer findings (Copilot, Codex, CodeQL, linters) were dispositioned like human feedback
- [ ] Relevant tests were re-run after addressing feedback
- [ ] Re-review was requested for any blocking finding (security, privacy, migration, data integrity, production reliability)
- [ ] No current unresolved P0/P1 thread remains
- [ ] Required checks pass on the final head commit
- [ ] `session_log.md` records the final validation, unresolved risks and handoff status
